create_sync_vector_env: create a SyncVectorEnv instance with multiple Habitat environments for parallelized training
reset_vector_env: reset all vectorized environments and return observations from each
step_vector_env: step through all vectorized environments with actions and return observations, rewards, done flags
pause_resume_envs: pause individual environments and resume them later without destroying env state
call_env_function: call a named function on a specific environment by index and return the result
